title: close(interpreter_filter_sort): traceability table and R1 coverage

req_statements.R1: Each library record shall persist an interpreter (artist), resolved from the catalogue lookup, from the tags already embedded in the audio file, or from the title pattern, in that order.
req_statements.R2: Each item exposed over `GET /library` shall carry its interpreter, and the card shall show it.
req_statements.R3: The panel shall allow filtering the list by interpreter with a text query.
req_statements.R4: The panel shall allow sorting by title, interpreter or date added, with an ascending/descending direction.
req_statements.R5: Filtering and sorting shall survive the polling refreshes.
